bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for a grant to the public housing agency of the city of St. Paul.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; ST. PAUL PUBLIC HOUSING AGENCY. +]

[+$20,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Minnesota Housing Finance Agency for a grant to the public housing agency for the city of St. Paul and its affiliated entities, including its wholly controlled nonprofit corporation, Capital City Affordable Housing, to rehabilitate, preserve, equip, and repair its deeply affordable single-family home and duplex units. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for a grant to the public housing agency of the city of St. Paul.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; ST. PAUL PUBLIC HOUSING AGENCY.

$20,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Minnesota Housing Finance Agency for a grant to the public housing agency for the city of St. Paul and its affiliated entities, including its wholly controlled nonprofit corporation, Capital City Affordable Housing, to rehabilitate, preserve, equip, and repair its deeply affordable single-family home and duplex units. This is a onetime appropriation.
